title: A timer and a temporary change
description:
Write two context managers: one as a class and one with `contextlib`.

```
sorting took 0.01s
inside: debug
after: info
```
hints: `__exit__(self, kind, error, trace)` runs however the block ends; return `False` (or nothing) so an error is not swallowed.
In the generator, `try: yield` and `finally:` put the old value back (lesson 7.02).
requirements: `class Timer` with `__enter__` and `__exit__` that prints `<label> took <seconds>s` (two decimals) when the block ends, even if it raised.
`@contextmanager def temporarily(settings, key, value)` sets `settings[key]` and puts the old value back afterwards, even if the block raised.
stretch: Make `temporarily` remove the key afterwards if it did not exist before.
